review.tagline: Node.js voice AI agent starter for LiveKit Agents with turn detection
review.summary: A TypeScript template for a voice AI assistant built on LiveKit Agents for Node.js. The voice pipeline defaults to LiveKit Inference (Gemma 4 31B LLM, Fish Audio S2.1 Pro TTS), with turn detection in 14 languages, adaptive interruption handling and background voice cancellation. It includes a Dockerfile, a scenarios.yaml with CI simulations, and an AGENTS.md for coding agents.
review.audience: Node.js developers building voice agents on LiveKit
strengths: Turn detector (14 languages) and adaptive interruption handling included by default
Simulation scenarios in scenarios.yaml run in CI on every merge to main
Ships AGENTS.md and an agent debugger for testing one text turn at a time
Pairs with listed starters for React, Swift, Flutter, Android, React Native and telephony
weaknesses: Default setup requires a LiveKit Cloud account and API keys
Inference and simulations run on LiveKit Cloud; self-hosting means swapping in model plugins
Noise cancellation plugin is LiveKit Cloud only and must be removed when self-hosting
pnpm-lock.yaml is not tracked in the template
needs: TypeScript, LiveKit Inference (Gemma 4 31B, Fish Audio S2.1 Pro), OpenAI, Cartesia, Deepgram
Needs LiveKit Cloud, LiveKit CLI 2.18.8+, pnpm, Node.js
